core_obligations: Write the Cech terms and differential on the standard cover
Grade the complex by Z^(n+1) weights of monomials
Build the contracting homotopy and conclude acyclicity
difficulty_reason: Cohomology of projective space over a ring: computes the Cech complex of O(d) on the standard affine cover explicitly, introduces the Z^(n+1)-grading on the terms R[T]_d, builds the weight-graded contraction h with (hd + dh)(s) = s, so the identity is homotopic to zero and the complex is acyclic. Retained author proof at lines 1841-2057.
